description: Oct. 5 reports name Annaba, Constantine, Jijel, Oran and Akbou but provide no location-specific attendance estimates. Arrest totals do not establish crowd size.
required_followup: Search each named locality in French, Arabic and local/regional outlets; keep event-level counts separate.

description: Algiers Oct. 5 reporting refers to spontaneous and later processions with different estimates. The available sources do not establish whether they were one continuous event or separate gatherings.
required_followup: Compare precise time/location and organizers across reports and check September/November unit dossiers before approval.

description: The regional report describes Kabylie marches on Oct. 2–3 but gives inconsistent weekday wording for Oct. 3 and does not assign every city report to a precise date.
required_followup: Find contemporaneous local reports for Vgayet, Kherrata and Imceddalen and identify separate action dates.

description: The Imceddalen attempted march and follow-up gathering have no participant count. Arrests and tensions cannot be used as turnout estimates.
required_followup: Seek contemporary local attendance evidence and determine whether the follow-up at the police station was separate.

description: The Oct. 8 Oran anti-femicide march may have been prevented before it formed; approximately 20 arrests/interceptions do not establish participant count.
required_followup: Find contemporaneous local reporting or an original statement establishing turnout before intervention.

description: VAVA innova pages for the Oct. 26 Bouchktiam blockade and Oct. 27 municipal-employee gathering rendered title-only on open. They remain search-only; grievance, public target, attendance and response are unknown.
required_followup: If further ordinary public retrieval is possible after a fresh exact-URL check, inspect article text; do not treat title-only evidence as confirmation.

description: The Arabic Oct. 26 Ouled Hachich result suggests a local-development grievance and partial tramway disruption but gives no attendance or direct state-target evidence in the captured header.
required_followup: Locate and review the body in Arabic; verify attendance, demand target and state response.

description: Relevant L’Orient-Le Jour and New Arab/Al-Araby search results were not opened because the assignment identifies these affected holds. A possible wire origin for Channels Television’s Oct. 5 report is unresolved. Facebook links were not opened.
required_followup: Keep held sources and ambiguous AP/wire relationships out of event evidence unless exact source/alias/origin review documents permitted access. Facebook content remains unreviewed.

description: Searches found an announced PAD mobilization for Oct. 10, an Oct. 14 taxi-driver sit-in proposal and an Oct. 1 ADA strike threat, but no reliable report that any proposed action occurred.
required_followup: No event coding unless a contemporary report or primary record confirms an executed public gathering.

description: Available evidence describes a return of Hirak marches in early October after the pandemic pause, but no full month-by-month continuity review was completed for adjacent months. The Oct. 2–5 events are not treated as one continuous nationwide episode.
required_followup: Compare neighboring unit dossiers and contemporaneous reports to confirm onsets, closures and national versus local organization.

description: Search effort used English, French and Arabic query forms across dates, Hirak/referendum issues, gender-based violence, worker actions and local-service grievances. Regional, sector-specific and week-by-week discovery remains uneven; search engines exposed no result totals and may ignore date filters.
required_followup: Continue with local press archives and more targeted Arabic/French searches by wilaya, week and sector; do not interpret unlocated events as absent.

description: No LexisNexis-equivalent newspaper archive was available. The public web search surface cannot establish complete coverage of local papers, print-only material or syndicated reports.
required_followup: Review an authorized archive or baseline when available; current web discovery does not support an exhaustiveness claim.

description: The supplied demand categories have no dedicated gender-based-violence category. Political behavior/processes is assigned provisionally for the Oct. 8 Algiers action and requires review.
required_followup: Reviewer should decide whether the state-protection demand fits the supplied political-process category or remains uncoded.

description: No official country-code provenance was supplied for this unit, so ccode remains null. Search-tool native response metadata and exact execution timestamps were unavailable; rendered headers and tool-call order were recorded without invented values.
required_followup: Populate official ccode only from supplied provenance; preserve unknown query clocks and native metadata.
